/work/ESPRIT-EDGE-PDF-to-3D.mp4.title: PDF drawing to 3D in ESPRIT EDGE
/work/ESPRIT-EDGE-PDF-to-3D.mp4.description: A screen-recorded demonstration of the Auto 3D workflow: open a drawing, enter its dimensions and build a solid inside ESPRIT EDGE.
steps: Select the source drawing in Auto 3D.
Enter the dimensions shown on the drawing.
Build and inspect the resulting solid in ESPRIT EDGE.

/work/VISI-Electrode-Workflow.mp4.title: Electrode preparation in VISI
/work/VISI-Electrode-Workflow.mp4.description: A screen-recorded tooling workflow showing electrode selection, stock preparation, stock-origin positioning and identification on a mould model.
steps: Select electrode geometry on the mould model.
Prepare stock and position the stock origin.
Review the electrode identification and placement.

/work/Mold-Motion-Study.mp4.title: Mold Motion Study
/work/Mold-Motion-Study.mp4.description: A screen-recorded VISI mold motion study showing the opening stroke, side core and ejector pin movement, and collision detection between moving components.
steps: Design the mold with core, cavity, side core and ejector pins.
Define the fixed half and the moving half of the mold.
Set up the motion study in VISI: mold opening direction and stroke, side core travel, ejector pin travel.
Run the simulation and watch the side core and ejector pins move through the full cycle.
Run collision detection and review any interference between components.
Fix the design or the motion timing and re-run until the mold moves clean.
